fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm or sliding gate at the public road (Lake Rd) or anywhere on the long internal access driveway. Street View 2009/2019 confirms an open campus driveway running from Lake Rd, past a pond, with only a monument sign at the road entrance. Open-campus archetype.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth visible at the building, the trailer-yard mouth, or the driveway. The DC operates from a wholly internal driveway with no checkpoint structure. Listed uncertain because z20 winter imagery is mid-resolution; no booth-footprint structure found in any view.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two distinct large buildings on the same parcel cluster: the main UNFI DC (brown roof with rooftop solar) and a separate older warehouse to the north (white/teal roof with its own trailer parking).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved area inside the property between the driveway and the trailer drop yards / dock aprons gives ample internal queuing room.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots: a large fan of parked trailers SE of the building and additional rows north of the building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along the south face and wrap to the west face; appears to be one operational dock complex, not physically separate ship/rcv banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~60 across the south and west building faces from the rhythm of dock bays and backed-in trailers; mid-resolution winter imagery makes an exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park in Dayville/Killingly CT, surrounded by woods, fields, a reservoir, and a few other industrial buildings - rural setting.
